text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the wake of her earlier press conference, Sweep Tosho becomes the runner to watch at the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Roused by Sweep Tosho, other Umamusume on the Triple Tiara tour begin to declare their own ambitions for victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy watches on as the excitement builds… And soon, the race itself begins.
